name: Car Scratch and chipping paint, pencil paint with brush (Only WHITE COLOUR)
description: DescriptionCar paint for repairing chips and scratches on the car. Car paint in a multifunctional bottle with a brush is convenient to touch up thin scratches and small chips. Can be applied on metal and plastic, on all parts of cars and motorcycles. Paint does not require finishing varnish. Applied in 2-3 layers if necessary, fills deep chips well. In case of deep damage, it is desirable to pre-apply the soil. The presented high-quality concentrated car paint has a high hiding quality and drying speed, which will allow you: to quickly and efficiently carry out pre-sale preparation of the car, to perform a small repair of the paintwork yourself: to tint chips, eliminate scratches and small defects. Please note that some of our catalog's paints are presented in the basic and acrylic version, so consider the type of car coating when choosing. If it is difficult to determine the type of coating, then it is better to opt for the basic tint, as the most universal.
